request.task: Certify OBX-AUTH-R1-P1-SOLO-001 inside the wave-2 Release 1 governance change as corrected by the P2 predecessor-gate fix
request.head: ea2eccba6e3e0f4acba447226b5d96b41e1394f1

audit.proof_assessment: validatePredecessorGate no longer treats presence of OBX-AUTH-R1-P1-SOLO-001 allowedPaths (including expectedAbsentFiles) as a pending-gate failure; that is the predecessor doing authorized work. Required refusals are implemented on the live PENDING path: program-manifest children of OBX-P210; P2-only paths not in P2_PRE_EXISTING_PHASE_ONLY_PATHS; that 13-list must be P2-only and currently present; binding.files must equal the live predecessor allowedPaths; pending checkpointCommit must be null; predecessor must be present, unexpired, and implementationAuthorized. COMPLETED_VERIFIED is untouched. P1/P2 registry records still carry expectedAbsentFiles; the first three frozen records are only comma-extended. This does not weaken the recorded boundary relative to the stated presence semantics. The pin list cannot be silently abused without editing the hashed verifier/receipts, and it is self-calibrating against the current tree (omit an existing P2-only path and the gate fails; pin a non-phase-only path and the gate fails). The remaining P2-before-P1-merge escape is outside the stated presence rule: edits to the thirteen pre-existing files and to shared P1/P2 paths are invisible to this gate.
residual_risks: Presence-only enforcement: P2 may edit all 13 P2_PRE_EXISTING_PHASE_ONLY_PATHS and every shared P1/P2 path (contracts, pageIrController, releaseLifecycleStore, LifecycleStatus, preview-workbench) before P1 merges; only new P2-only paths (candidatePromotion.ts and the fingerprint design note) and OBX-P210-* manifest rows are blocked.

P2_PRE_EXISTING_PHASE_ONLY_PATHS is not proven with git at 4b02f75f—only existsSync now. A later activation-write-set change that adds a path to the list and creates the file in the same change could launder new P2 work as pre-existing.
Child-ticket refusal is live but inert in the intended workflow: P1/P2 child tickets are kept off docs/tickets/one-box-program/manifest.json, so that control does not constrain actual P2 start.
COMPLETED_VERIFIED remains untested dead code until PHASES and the P2 record are updated together.
Tree occupancy uses existsSync rather than the module's symlink-safe lstat/isFile reader; a broken symlink at a new P2-only path would not trip predecessor-phase-not-merged.
